title: Topological Dependencies
summary: Order a directed acyclic dependency graph so every prerequisite appears before each vertex that depends on it.
recognition_signals: the output must respect every dependency
a dependency cycle would make a complete order impossible
core_rules: A valid topological order exists only for a DAG.
A vertex becomes available only after all of its incoming prerequisite edges have been satisfied.
structural_steps: compute prerequisite counts or DFS dependency state
detect a cycle if not all vertices can be emitted

common_confusions.distinction: Ordinary traversal explores reachability. Topological ordering must additionally respect directed prerequisite constraints and reject cycles.
